title: 实现隐私保护的生产口令泄露风险适配器
changed_contracts: Adds an internal GatewayAuth Infrastructure implementation of the existing mandatory ILocalSecretRiskChecker port; no public wire contract, Host route or lifecycle outcome changed.
Fixes the provider protocol to the HIBP HTTPS range endpoint with five-character SHA-1 prefixes, Add-Padding, strict bounded responses and fail-closed outcomes; no database contract changed.
risks: HIBP availability is an external dependency; after a valid prefix range expires, any provider or parsing failure intentionally blocks credential writes rather than using stale allow data.

The adapter is component-only and is not composed into the Host; first-administrator bootstrap, out-of-band recovery, TLS, deployment secrets, persistent keys, Cookie/Origin protections and upstream abuse control remain missing.
Future Host composition must verify outbound HTTP diagnostic redaction so the range path/prefix does not enter logs or high-cardinality telemetry.
No live HIBP request or GitHub-hosted Linux CI ran in this task; controlled transport tests are not represented as external reachability evidence.

reused_existing_logic: Reuses V01-012 ILocalSecretRiskChecker, LocalSecretRisk, LocalSecret and LocalAccountLifecycleService as the mandatory fail-closed path before any credential derivation or store call.
Reuses the existing LocalSecret lifetime and zeroization boundary; SHA-1 exists only inside the provider query adapter and the PBKDF2-SHA256 credential policy is unchanged.
Uses .NET 10 BCL HttpClient, SocketsHttpHandler, streams, cryptography, collections and TimeProvider without adding packages, languages, frameworks or services.
cross_module_access: All provider code remains under GatewayAuth Infrastructure and only implements an Application-owned internal port.
No other module table, schema, internal entity, filesystem path or mutable state is read or written.
No Host, public contract, generated SDK, migration, database role or dependency lock changed.
contract_changes: Adds a component-only HIBP range adapter behind the existing internal secret-risk port with fixed request, parsing, timeout and cache limits.
Does not change public APIs, lifecycle outcomes, database contracts or any release/write capability.
architecture_tests: Locked restore, format verification, zero-warning Release build and all 244 .NET tests passed; WebGateway is 60/60 with 24 provider-specific tests.
21 connection-free migration manifest, 54 repository, 14 architecture and 32 release tests passed; repository, server-release and Alpha validators passed.
v0.1-start remains allowed, while Alpha --require-ready and v0.1-release retain native exit code 3 with production authentication and all prior release blockers intact.
technical_debt: Implement first-administrator bootstrap and out-of-band recovery with deployment authorization, idempotency, rotation and no-secret audit before exposing account management.
Compose the provider only after outbound HTTP telemetry redaction, TLS, persistent keys, secure cookies, Origin/CSRF and upstream abuse controls are verified end to end.
Keep business APIs and every production file-write path disabled until their existing integration and durability gates close.
